exposure: Reclassification as GDM by WHO-2013 criteria
cohort: Pregnant women referred for an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) at Erasmus MC between 2010 and 2015.
finding: Implementing the WHO-2013 criteria significantly increased GDM prevalence, with newly diagnosed patients exhibiting higher BMI and delivering babies with higher birth weight, although maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes were comparable between criteria groups.
